event_chain.summary: Records and slides discarded in a dumpster

summary: On July 8, 2026, a member of the public found boxes of patient billing statements and thousands of microscope slides with patient data in a dumpster about three miles from Gem State Dermatology in Boise, Idaho, and told the practice. It began an investigation into how the materials were discarded and how many patients were affected.
